reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 10 and targeted source panel/note crops, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/paperclip crop, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png; checked cap emblems, covered hair, brows, absence of facial hair and glasses, open smile, uniform, pose, crop, lighting, collar fit, original dark frame, note marks/tab versus added paperclip, backplate and visible transparency.

remaining_reasons: The original has a complete dark tilted photo frame, but the return changes its visible outer frame to a pale cream/white border. Restore the source's dark frame color, surface and wear rather than lightening the frame.

The returned note adds a large metallic paperclip at its upper-right edge, absent from the original, and the source's small dark right-edge tab is not retained in its original position/form. Remove the invented paperclip and restore the original small dark tab without adding replacement hardware.

The enlarged source note has TWO compact faint upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper. The returned native note instead has THREE darker, larger handwriting-like rows. Remove the invented third row and restore only the source-scale compact two-row upper footprint without inventing lettering.
entries.positive_observation: The light grey-olive peaked cap retains a dark band, shiny black visor, pale metallic cord/piping and two vertically separated silver-toned front emblems. Hair remains covered, dark eyebrows are present, and the face has no moustache, beard or glasses. The single open friendly smile with visible teeth, near-frontal three-quarter pose, upright shoulders, chest-up crop and bright facial light under visor shadow are retained. The dark grey-green tunic, light pointed shirt collar, dark tie and small pale collar/shoulder details remain; the rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The photographic backplate remains opaque pale warm grey-beige, and the note remains cream with mostly blank lower paper. Full white/cyan comparisons show a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, missing backing or working-matte ring; these positive properties do not offset the clear frame/note alterations listed above.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap-emblem shapes, tiny collar/shoulder insignia and note lettering cannot be read reliably at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection depends on clearly visible frame color, the added paperclip/missing tab and two-versus-three note rows, all resolved in the enlarged source and native return rather than inferred from fine unreadable details.
